_comment: Combat achievement tasks whose restrictions shape a set (ISS-01M5WTTT491S23YYFS0HSBCRDT). Wiki-sourced (read 2026-10-27, Combat_Achievements/All_tasks); id = the wiki's task number, which the completion varps index (caId when one task is split per mob, as Betrayal is per moon). mobs = the monsters' lowercase names; version = a fragment the mob's version must contain. Rules: rules = [stat, op, value] over the worn totals (SetRules.Rule; besides the bonus stats, has:<name> counts items whose name starts with it, price sums the gear's value); weapons = weapon names (every version), weaponCategories = weapon categories, demonbaneWeapon = a demonbane weapon - a weapon must match one of those when any is given; banned = items never worn; bannedDemonbane = no demonbane weapon; oneHanded = no two-handed weapon; unarmed = no weapon at all (melee punches, magic casts manually); noWeaponMagic = magic may also cast with no weapon; styles = the combat styles allowed; attackType = the one melee attack type; noPrayer = no prayers; noPrayerRestore = no prayer-restoring supplies; spellbook = the one spellbook; spells = name fragments the spell must contain; levelCap = no item needing a level above it; mobWeapons = a weapon list per mob (one task, each mob its own weapon); poisonWeapon = the weapon poisons or envenoms; f2p = a free-to-play world (the F2P lock). Recoil damage (Prayer Smasher) is banned through its items; Vengeance is not modelled as damage. Finishing-blow and low-hitpoint tasks are left out (they need no whole-fight set), and so are the "without losing prayer points" tasks (Andrew 2026-10-27: mechanic, not gear).
